editorial_structure.key_insight: MORA는 여성성을 장식하지 않고, 한 사람이 재료를 고르고 변화를 지켜보고 멈출 때를 판단하며 내놓기 전 마지막 상태를 기록하는 책임으로 보여 준다.
editorial_structure.brand_in_one_sentence: 르라보가 작업자·재료·랩·기록·개인화로 장인성을 드러냈다면, MORA는 여성 메이커의 엄선·발효·거름·중간상태·마지막 확인을 한 컵과 Batch Record에 남긴다.

stage_3_truth_gates.batch_record: maker marks only after a real operational check and traceability procedure exists

ingredient or scent name plus number naming architecture

assumptions: MORA and all product names are directional working names pending trademark and linguistic clearance.
The female maker is an approved symbolic brand archetype, not a verified founder biography or universal gender role.
All six recipes, 150 g format, intermediate states, process language and label fields remain directional until food R&D and legal approval.
Dark brick and concrete define a non-food-contact shell and image world; real food-contact zones require cleanable sealed surfaces and hygienic zoning.
The transparent wide-mouth jar, closure, paper label, adhesive, ink and outer carrier are unvalidated production candidates.
The new S2 revision supersedes the direct-print-only and warm mineral-ivory directions; S3 must not be synchronized before S2 acceptance.
factual_limits: Do not invent founder name, age, profession, family status, origin place, health story, family recipe, first batch, number of experiments or direct quotation.
Do not claim handmade, small-batch, natural, organic, high-protein, low-sugar, probiotic, digestive, medical, origin, sustainability or superior-quality benefits without evidence.
Do not present generated maker, room, process, intermediate state or package imagery as proof of an actual founder, facility, SOP, batch or food-contact specification.
Do not use handwritten marks for mandatory food, allergen, storage, lot, serve-by or legal information.
Do not make brick, concrete, wear, darkness or paper imply sanitation, authenticity or environmental benefit by appearance alone.
Do not lock actual process time, temperature, pH, yield, strain duration, infusion formulation, fold count, fill, seal, storage or shelf life before validation.
Fig Leaf requires species, plant part, latex, furanocoumarin, preparation and regulatory review; Olive Oil & Sea Salt requires oxidation, emulsion, salt and sensory validation.
Dark mood imagery cannot substitute for color-accurate product, ingredient, texture, label-legibility or hygiene proof.
